correctness.rationale: The method’s exact one-step integral gives \(\Phi=qI+(1-q)J\). The decomposition of all matrix degrees of freedom into cyclic diagonal modes and zero-jump off-diagonal modes proves the two norms. The derivative bound \(F_a\prime(q)<0\) for \(a\le3/2\) establishes the all-step cases and the exact factorizations establish thresholds \(\log3\) and \(\log2\). The strong-step trace limit follows from uniform finite-dimensional convergence and the simplex extreme point. The embedded verifier independently checks algebra and matrices on finite instances, not universal proof.

value.rationale: Large-step equilibration rates and state trace errors matter for structure-preserving Lindblad simulation. The theorem quantifies an exponential stiffness obstruction that is not ruled out by complete positivity, trace conservation, or an exactly preserved stationary state. Exact all-step dimension thresholds, operator-wide contraction, and sharp trace-error limit form a motivated complete classification, not an arbitrary small numerical example.
